module: Node "Set Vehicle Active" (category `once_instant`). Makes a vehicle visible or invisible (`obj:setActive(1 or 0)`). Input pins: `vehId` (default: player), `active` (bool).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

workOnce.desc: Applies `setActive` to the vehicle according to the `active` pin.
